title: Paul Defends His Ministry

questions.question: Paul entreats them by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—Paul who is ____ when face to face with them, but bold when away!
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:1 (ESV): "I, Paul, myself entreat you, by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am humble when face to face with you, but bold toward you when I am away!—"

questions.question: He begs them that when he is present he may not have to show boldness with such ____ as he counts on showing against some who suspect him of walking according to the flesh.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:2 (ESV): "I beg of you that when I am present I may not have to show boldness with such confidence as I count on showing against some who suspect us of walking according to the flesh."

questions.question: For though we walk in the flesh, we are not waging war according to the ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:3 (ESV): "For though we walk in the flesh, we are not waging war according to the flesh."

questions.question: For the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh but have divine power to destroy ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:4 (ESV): "For the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh but have divine power to destroy strongholds."

questions.question: We destroy arguments and every lofty opinion raised against the knowledge of God, and take every thought captive to obey ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:5 (ESV): "We destroy arguments and every lofty opinion raised against the knowledge of God, and take every thought captive to obey Christ,"

questions.question: Paul says they are being ready to punish every disobedience, when what is complete?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:6 (ESV): "being ready to punish every disobedience, when your obedience is complete."

questions.question: Look at what is before your ____. If anyone is confident that he is Christ's, let him remind himself that just as he is Christ's, so also are we.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:7 (ESV): "Look at what is before your eyes. If anyone is confident that he is Christ's, let him remind himself that just as he is Christ's, so also are we."

questions.question: For even if Paul boasts a little too much of his authority, which the Lord gave for ____, he will not be ashamed.
options: building you up and not for destroying you
questions.correctAnswer: building you up and not for destroying you
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:8 (ESV): "For even if I boast a little too much of our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for destroying you, I will not be ashamed."

questions.question: What do some say of Paul's letters and his bodily presence? "His letters are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is ____, and his speech of no account."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:10 (ESV): "For they say, 'His letters are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account.'"

questions.question: Let such a person understand that what Paul says by letter when absent, he does when ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:11 (ESV): "Let such a person understand that what we say by letter when absent, we do when present."

questions.question: Not that we dare to classify or compare ourselves with some of those who are commending themselves. But when they measure themselves by one another and compare themselves with one another, they are without ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:12 (ESV): "But when they measure themselves by one another and compare themselves with one another, they are without understanding."

questions.question: But we will not boast beyond limits, but will boast only with regard to the area of ____ God assigned to us.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:13 (ESV): "But we will not boast beyond limits, but will boast only with regard to the area of influence God assigned to us, to reach even to you."

questions.question: For we are not ____ ourselves, as though we did not reach you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:14 (ESV): "For we are not overextending ourselves, as though we did not reach you. For we were the first to come all the way to you with the gospel of Christ."

questions.question: Paul hopes that as their faith increases, his area of influence among them may be greatly enlarged, so that he may preach the gospel in lands ____ them, without boasting of work already done in another's area.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:15-16 (ESV): "our hope is that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you may be greatly enlarged, so that we may preach the gospel in lands beyond you..."

questions.question: "Let the one who boasts, boast in the ____." For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:17-18 (ESV): "'Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord.' For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends."
